description: Tom Bradley responds to Priya Sharma's direct outreach. Accepts the one-on-one conversation she requested. Comes in without a managed performance — acknowledges he is watching the same policy-count data she is, asks what she is actually thinking about doing, and listens. This is the first genuine peer-to-peer exchange between them rather than a managed professional transaction.

on_sender.stress_delta: slight_reduction — releasing the performance posture costs less energy than maintaining it
on_sender.agency_delta: small_positive — taking an honest action after several ticks of managed inaction

on_recipient.trust_delta_tom: neutral to positive — Priya gets the honest conversation she signaled she wanted
on_recipient.information_shared: Tom's real assessment of his own position and timeline concerns
